{{/* L1 Atmosphere ThemePreset chrome (not a Cap). Hooks: data-brew-theme-preset / .brew-theme-preset__* Beer: button.circle + panel surface slots. Call: partial "theme-preset.html" . or partial "theme-preset.html" (dict "Page" . "align" "start") Leading seed: Site.Params.mdfriday.beerSeed (+ beerSeedLabel). Align: dict.align | mdfriday.themePresetAlign | "end". */}} {{- $page := . -}} {{- $alignOverride := "" -}} {{- if reflect.IsMap . -}} {{- $page = index . "Page" | default . -}} {{- $alignOverride = index . "align" | default "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- $mdf := index $page.Site.Params "mdfriday" | default dict -}} {{- $seed := index $mdf "beerSeed" | default "" -}} {{- $seedLabel := index $mdf "beerSeedLabel" | default "" -}} {{- $align := $alignOverride | default (index $mdf "themePresetAlign" | default "end") -}} {{- if and $align (ne $align "start") (ne $align "end") -}}{{- $align = "end" -}}{{- end -}} {{- if not $seedLabel -}} {{- if eq $seed "#eb5600" -}}{{- $seedLabel = "Cursor" -}} {{- else if eq $seed "#cc785c" -}}{{- $seedLabel = "Claude" -}} {{- else if eq $seed "#960462" -}}{{- $seedLabel = "Garden" -}} {{- else if eq $seed "#3366cc" -}}{{- $seedLabel = "Vector" -}} {{- else if $seed -}}{{- $seedLabel = "Brand" -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Skip leading chip when seed already appears as a named catalog preset. */ -}} {{- $leadSeed := "" -}} {{- if and $seed (ne $seed "#960462") (ne $seed "#3366cc") (ne $seed "#0d9373") (ne $seed "#1a365d") -}} {{- $leadSeed = $seed -}} {{- end -}}
{{- with $leadSeed -}} {{- end -}}
